# FFmpeg

FindFX bundles the unmodified Windows x64 `ffmpeg.exe` from Gyan's
FFmpeg 8.1.2 essentials build, compressed in `ffmpeg.zip`.
It is extracted in the disposable runtime and invoked as a separate process.
No FFmpeg code is linked into the Unity package's C# assemblies.

- Build: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/packages/ffmpeg-8.1.2-essentials_build.zip
- Build information and source links: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
- Release mirror: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/8.1.2
- Exact FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/38b88335f9
- Executable SHA-256: `1326DDE4C84FF1F96FE6B8916C5BED29E163E9B5DCCF995F6F3DB069D143EC5E`
